assets.name: household-vegetable-storage-v1
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: a 3:2 landscape photo of food storage beside a refrigerator photo in a Japanese family cooking app. A candid realistic photograph of a small Japanese home kitchen vegetable storage area OUTSIDE the refrigerator: breathable shallow wicker and wire baskets on a low light wood open shelf holding brown onions and ordinary unpeeled potatoes. Include a modest pantry shelf with a few unbranded sealed containers and cooking oil in the background. No people, no hands, no text, no logos or labels, no generated UI, no arrows. Clean but lived-in home, soft natural window light, neutral cream and muted wood palette, natural vegetable skins, realistic photographic material and shadows. Fill the frame with the vegetable baskets, an eye-level slight downward view, legible when used as a small thumbnail. No refrigerator in this image; this photograph specifically shows a separate vegetable storage area.

assets.name: concept-family-schedule-v4
assets.prompt: Edit target: the attached warm watercolor/cut-paper illustration of a mother, father and child planning dinner at a kitchen table. Change ONLY the flat white paper calendar at the center of the tabletop into a clearly recognizable LARGE LANDSCAPE TABLET with a dark sage gray device bezel and subtle glass screen reflection, lying at a low natural angle on that same table. The mother's pointing finger should touch the tablet screen. On the tablet screen, show a simple app screen with a weekly schedule grid using muted colored blocks, and a small meal suggestion area with a curry plate thumbnail and shared cooking task icons. Do not add readable words or numbers. Keep the tablet naturally oriented toward the family, in the perspective of the tabletop; do NOT prop it upright toward the camera. Preserve the original composition, the three people, faces, clothing, kitchen, food, father's naturally held phone with its back toward the viewer, warm paper texture, palette, lighting and 3:2 aspect ratio. The tablet must look unmistakably like a digital device with a substantial bezel, not a paper sheet.
assets.refinement: Edit only the tablet in the supplied illustration. It is currently MUCH too large. Shrink its long edge to 60% of its current length and shrink its short edge proportionally, making it an ordinary realistic 10–11 inch household tablet about 25 cm wide, similar to the length of an adult forearm, and small enough to occupy one normal place setting on the dining table. Leave clear empty tabletop around the smaller tablet. Keep it lying at the same low natural angle near the mother and child, and adjust only the mother's fingertip/pointing hand if necessary so she touches the smaller screen naturally. Preserve the schedule grid and tiny meal/task icons inside the screen, but scale that UI down with the tablet; the UI must not force the physical device to become oversized. Preserve everything else: three people, faces, clothing, father's phone and natural pose, food, table, kitchen, warm watercolor and cut-paper texture, palette, viewpoint, lighting and 3:2 format. No text or logos.
assets.orientationCorrection: Precise edit of ONLY the tablet screen contents in the attached family illustration. The tablet UI currently faces the VIEWER, but the family is sitting on the OPPOSITE far side of the table. Rotate the ENTIRE interface 180 degrees WITHIN the plane of the tablet screen, preserving its perspective. The header/calendar weekday row must move to the NEAR edge closest to the camera and be upside down to us; the curry thumbnail and cooking task icons must move to the FAR edge nearest the child and also be upside down to us. The family should see the interface right way up, while the camera sees the entire interface upside down. Do not just rotate individual icons; rotate the complete screen layout as one surface. Do NOT rotate or enlarge the physical tablet, do NOT change the hand touching it, and do NOT change the tablet's size, position or perspective. Preserve all people, faces, clothes, food, background, father's phone, table, lighting, watercolor and cut-paper texture, and composition exactly. No added letters, words or logos.
